name: pedal
description: Build CLAP/AU/VST3 effects and synths that Codex can hear and rewire — live, while they run in your DAW.

interface.shortDescription: Author live CLAP/AU/VST3 pedals and synths from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Pedal is a CLAP/AU/VST3 plugin whose DSP is a node graph you edit while it runs. With this plugin, Codex can inspect the graph of a pedal loaded in your DAW, rewire it, bind knobs, render audio to hear the result, and hot-swap the change into the running instance — no reload, no rebuild. Describe the sound you want and iterate on it by ear.
defaultPrompt: Make the delay darker and give me a feedback knob
Build me a gritty fuzz with a tone control, then let me hear it
This synth patch sounds thin — find the problem and fix it
